subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful, resettable after-compaction hooks gain a supported current-session `resetSession(reason?)` plugin API?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive plugin capability with permanent availability and failure semantics; code review cannot determine whether OpenClaw wants that contract or whether the recovery should remain owner-specific.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook API
options.body: Support the method only for successful, resettable after-compaction contexts with lifecycle-owned deferred draining and documented semantics.

options.title: Keep reset owner-specific
options.body: Move the recovery into the owning context or memory integration rather than establishing a general hook-context API.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Support the method only for successful, resettable after-compaction contexts with lifecycle-owned deferred draining and documented semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the introduction of the compaction hook family whose public context contract this PR extends.
